title: Add dagsterplus provider package
body:
## Summary
Adds the `dagsterplus` community provider package (`dagster-io/pulumi-dagsterplus` v0.0.1).

Re-push of #10932 to `pulumi/registry` (originally from a fork at `dehume/registry`) so the `Test Live Registry Publish` check can authenticate to ESC — `pull_request` runs from forks don't receive `id-token: write` and can't mint an OIDC token. Authorship preserved.

Original author: @dehume.

## Test plan
- [ ] All required checks pass, including `Test Live Registry Publish`
- [ ] `Sentinel Tower` reports success

Adding a community package? It is a one-line entry in [`community-packages/package-list.json`](https://github.com/pulumi/registry/blob/master/community-packages/package-list.json). See [Adding a new package](https://github.com/pulumi/registry/blob/master/docs/adding-a-new-package.md) for the steps. Automated checks post a fact-sheet on your PR telling you what passed and what to fix, and a Pulumi maintainer approves. Nothing merges automatically.
